```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(FReD)
library(glue)
library(furrr)

source("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forrtproject/FReD-data/refs/heads/main/clean_cos_fred.R")

fred_validated_raw <- read_csv("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vR_62H8liC0P3-WQ1xx4UalDnvqzPfObWBFwQAgVH6JhF3dPBFXd7AgFK_OljxFWQkNtUYdnUbuFTpe/pub?output=csv", skip = 1)

# filter for validated - chosen entries
fred_validated_raw <- fred_validated_raw[fred_validated_raw$status == "validated - chosen", ]

# remove excluded entries
fred_validated_raw <- fred_validated_raw[is.na(fred_validated_raw$exclusion), ]


clean_res <- clean_fred_data(fred_validated_raw)

clean_res$report

fred_validated <- clean_res$cleaned_data

fred_validated <- fred_validated %>% 
  mutate(fred_id = str_remove(id, "_[a-z]{1,2}[0-9]{0,1}$"))

```

## List of studies for subjective coding

```{r}
# convert original effect sizes
fred_validated$r_o <- convert_effect_sizes(es_values = fred_validated$es_value_o, es_types = fred_validated$es_type_o)  

# convert replication effect sizes
fred_validated$r_r <- convert_effect_sizes(es_values = fred_validated$es_value_r, es_types = fred_validated$es_type_r)

# directional effects
dir_types <- c("d", "r", "OR", "phi", "b (unstd)", "beta (std)", "beta", 
               "Mean difference", "percentage difference", "hedges' g",
               "median difference", "partial r", "Cohen's dz")

fred_validated <- fred_validated %>% 
  mutate(es_type_o = str_trim(es_type_o),
         es_type_r = str_trim(es_type_r))

fred_validated <- fred_validated %>% mutate(
  p_val_temp_r = coalesce(as.numeric(pval_value_r), FReD:::p_from_r(r_r, as.numeric(n_r))),
   p_val_temp_o = coalesce(as.numeric(pval_value_o), FReD:::p_from_r(r_o, as.numeric(n_o))),
  convertible = 
    (es_type_o %in% dir_types | str_detect(es_value_o, "^t|^Z|^z")) & 
       (es_type_r %in% dir_types | str_detect(es_value_r, "^t|^Z|^z")),
  replication_success = case_when(
    !convertible |  p_val_temp_o > .05 | 
      (p_val_temp_o == .05 & pval_type_o == "g (>)") | is.na(es_value_o) |
      is.na(es_value_r) | is.na(p_val_temp_r) | is.na(p_val_temp_o) ~ NA,
    (p_val_temp_r < .05 | (p_val_temp_r == .05 & pval_type_r == "l (<)")) & 
    sign(if_else(!is.na(r_r), r_r, as.numeric(es_value_r))) == 
    sign(if_else(!is.na(r_o), r_o, as.numeric(es_value_o))) ~ TRUE,
    .default = FALSE
  )) %>% 
  select(-convertible, p_val_temp_r, p_val_temp_o)
```


```{r cars}
missing_p <- fred_validated %>% 
  filter(is.na(as.numeric(pval_value_r)) | is.na(as.numeric(pval_value_o))) %>% 
  mutate(check_p_o = is.na(as.numeric(pval_value_o)), 
         check_p_r = is.na(as.numeric(pval_value_r))) %>% 
  select(rowid, check_p_o, check_p_r)

TEST_STAT_DIR_REGEX <- "^((t\\(\\d+(\\.\\d+)?\\)) ?= ?[\\-–\\+]?(\\d*\\.?\\d+|\\d+([eE][\\-–\\+]?\\d+)?)|[Zz] ?= ?[\\-–\\+]?(\\d*\\.?\\d+|\\d+([eE][\\-–\\+]?\\d+)?) ?, ?N ?= ?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?)$"

convert_es <- fred_validated %>%
  mutate(
    convertible_o = es_type_o %in% dir_types | str_detect(es_value_o, TEST_STAT_DIR_REGEX),
    convertible_r = es_type_r %in% dir_types | str_detect(es_value_r, TEST_STAT_DIR_REGEX),
    # Extract df1 from VALID F test
    df1_o = str_extract(
      es_value_o,
      "^F\\((\\d+(\\.\\d+)?), ?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?\\) ?= ?[\\-–\\+]?(\\d*\\.?\\d+|\\d+([eE][\\-–\\+]?\\d+)?)$",
      group = 1
    ) %>% as.numeric() %>% coalesce(0),
    df1_r = str_extract(
      es_value_r,
      "^F\\((\\d+(\\.\\d+)?), ?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?\\) ?= ?[\\-–\\+]?(\\d*\\.?\\d+|\\d+([eE][\\-–\\+]?\\d+)?)$",
      group = 1
    ) %>% as.numeric() %>% coalesce(0),
    # Extract df1 from VALID X2 test
    df1_o = str_extract(
      es_value_o,
      "^X2\\((\\d+(\\.\\d+)?)\\) ?= ?[\\-–\\+]?(\\d*\\.?\\d+|\\d+([eE][\\-–\\+]?\\d+)?)$",
      group = 1
    ) %>% as.numeric() %>% coalesce(df1_o),
    df1_r = str_extract(
      es_value_r,
      "^X2\\((\\d+(\\.\\d+)?)\\) ?= ?[\\-–\\+]?(\\d*\\.?\\d+|\\d+([eE][\\-–\\+]?\\d+)?)$",
      group = 1
    ) %>% as.numeric() %>% coalesce(df1_r)
  ) %>%
  filter((!convertible_o & df1_o < 2) | (!convertible_r & df1_r < 2)) %>%
  transmute(rowid, code_es_o = !convertible_o &  df1_o < 2, code_es_r = !convertible_r & df1_r < 2)


coding <- missing_p %>% full_join(convert_es) %>% 
  group_by(rowid) %>% 
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ c(coalesce(first(na.omit(.x)), FALSE))), 
            .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(as.numeric(rowid)) %>% 
  left_join(fred_validated) %>% 
  select(rowid, fred_id, claim_text_o, doi_o, link_o, doi_r, link_r, code_es_o, 
         code_es_r, check_p_o, check_p_r, es_value_o, es_type_o, es_repr_o, 
         pval_value_o, pval_type_o, pval_tails_o, es_value_r, es_type_r, es_repr_r, 
         pval_value_r, pval_type_r, pval_tails_r)
```

## Prep subj sucess

```{r}
subj <- fred_validated %>%
  select(fred_id, ref_o, doi_o, ref_r, doi_r,  url_r,  link_r, study_r) %>% 
  distinct(doi_o, doi_r, study_r, .keep_all = TRUE)

unique_dois <- na.omit(unique(subj$doi_r))

plan(multisession, workers = 4)

abstracts_r <- unique_dois %>% 
  future_map(function(x) {
    if (is.na(x)) {
      return(NA_character_)
    }
    possibly(rcrossref::cr_abstract, otherwise = NA_character_)(x) %>% unlist()
  }, .progress = TRUE)

abstracts_r_tbl <- tibble(doi_r = unique_dois,
                          abstract_r = unlist(abstracts_r))

subj <- subj %>% 
  left_join(abstracts_r_tbl)

subj %>% 
  left_join(abstracts_r_tbl) %>% 
  group_by(doi_r) %>% 
  mutate(entries_per_rep = n_distinct(fred_id)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(outcome = "", outcome_quote = "", out_quote_source = "abstract", other_task = fred_id %in% coding$fred_id) %>% 
  write_csv("subj_coding_Roksana.csv")
```

## Auto-code success


```{r}
library(ellmer)

code_abstract <- function(x) {
  
  if (is.na(x) || x == "") {
    return(list(success_rating = NA_character_, success_quote = NA_character_))
  }
  
  chat <- chat_openai(model = "gpt-5", params = params(service_tier = "flex"), api_args = list(reasoning_effort = "low"))
  
  chat$chat_structured(
    paste0("The following abstract reports the result of a replication study, or multiple replication studies. If it appears to concern the replication of ONE original paper, identify whether it reports the replication as 
           - 'successful'
           - 'failed'
           - 'mixed' (evidence both of success and of failure)
           - 'uninformative' (rare, e.g. if data collection failed) 
           - 'statistically successful but highlighting fundamental flaws' (when the abstract explicitly states that the statistical results were confirmed, but that they do not support the hypothesis)
           - or 'unclear' (when results of replication and original study are not direclty linked)
        Pick the SINGLE closest option. Return a direct quotation - the exact words and punctuation - that support the classification you made, which would typically include original and replication results. If you omit anything within the quotation, mark clearly with [...]. 
      If the abstract appears to refer to a paper reporting on multiple replications of *different* original studies, return NA as success_rating and preface the success_quote with [MULTIPLE?]", x),
    type = type_object(
      success_rating = type_string(),
      success_quote = type_string()
    )
  )
}

extra_abstracts <- readxl::read_excel("extra_ai.xlsx")

coded_abstracts <- extra_abstracts$abstract_r %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  map(code_abstract, .progress = TRUE)

res <- tibble(abstract_r = unique(extra_abstracts$abstract_r),  bind_rows(coded_abstracts))

  writexl::write_xlsx("AI_coded_extra.xlsx")


coded_abstracts <- subj$abstract_r %>%

res <- tibble(abstract_r = unique(extra_abstracts$abstract_r),  bind_rows(coded_abstracts))

subj <- subj %>% left_join(res)

library(stringdist)

quote_match <- function(quote, text, method = "lcs") {
  quote <- tolower(quote)
  text <- tolower(text)
  parts <- trimws(strsplit(quote, "\\[\\.\\.\\.\\]")[[1]])
  pos <- 1
  total <- 0
  for (part in parts) {
    if (nchar(part) == 0) next
    hay <- substring(text, pos)
    best_dist <- Inf
    best_end <- NA
    plen <- nchar(part)
    lens <- unique(c(max(1, plen - 1), plen, plen + 1))
    H <- nchar(hay)
    for (i in seq_len(H)) {
      for (l in lens) {
        if (i + l - 1 > H) next
        sub <- substr(hay, i, i + l - 1)
        d <- stringdist(part, sub, method = method)
        if (d < best_dist) {
          best_dist <- d
          best_end <- i + l - 1
        }
      }
    }
    if (is.infinite(best_dist)) return(Inf)
    total <- total + best_dist
    pos <- pos + best_end
    if (pos > nchar(text)) break
  }
  total
}

# example
quote_match("banana are [...] great", "green bananas are truly great")
quote_match("banana [...] are [...] great", "green bananas breads pieces are truly never great")


check_quote <- function(abstract, quote, remove = "[MULTIPLE?]") {
    quote <- quote %>% str_remove_all(fixed(remove))%>% tolower() %>% str_squish()
  if (is.na(abstract) || abstract == "" || is.na(quote) || quote == "") {
    return(data.frame(quote_detect = NA, quote_dist = NA))
  }
  abstract <- abstract %>% tolower() %>% str_squish()
  quotes <- quote %>% str_split(("\\[\\.\\.\\.\\]|\\.\\.\\.")) %>% unlist() %>% str_trim()
  data.frame(quote_detect = all(str_detect(abstract %>% str_remove_all("\\s"), fixed(quotes %>% str_remove_all("\\s")))), 
             quote_dist = stringdist::stringdist(quote, abstract, "lcs")- ((str_length(abstract) - str_length(quote))))
}

subj <- subj %>% mutate(success_quote = str_remove_all(success_quote, '"'))

subj2 <- subj %>%
  distinct(abstract_r, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(check_quote(abstract_r, success_quote)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate()

# Check for quote mismatch - usually due to encoding
subj2 %>% filter(!quote_detect) %>% writexl::write_xlsx("quote mismatch.xlsx")

subj <- subj %>%
  mutate(coded = !is.na(success_rating) & success_rating != "NA")

subj %>% 
  filter(coded) %>% 
  mutate(entries_per_rep = "") %>%
  select(everything(), entries_per_rep,  success_rating, success_quote) %>%
```

# Check matches and missing

```{r}

coded_results <- read_csv("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vSlPVImL7kjzMfpfX08JtAikvEiBg8uQ3HyEJs-YvuQMUa2RMvip-4v8-DilWl2PdwOD_UTD8gJ5wKA/pub?output=csv", skip = 1) %>% 
   mutate(doi_url_r = coalesce(url_r %>% na_if("NA"), doi_r),
          match_id = paste(doi_o, doi_url_r, na_if(study_o, "NA"), na_if(study_r, "NA"), sep = "_"))

coded_entries <- coded_results %>% 
  filter(validation != "validated - discarded") %>% 
  select(doi_o, doi_r, fred_id, study_r, url_r) %>% 
 distinct()
  

need_coding <- fred_validated %>%
  mutate(doi_url_r = coalesce(url_r %>% na_if("NA"), doi_r),
         match_id = paste(doi_o, doi_url_r, na_if(study_o, "NA"), na_if(study_r, "NA"), sep = "_"))

# matches
missing <- setdiff(coded_results %>% 
                     filter(!validation %in% c("validated - discarded", "on hold"))  %>%  
                     pull(match_id), 
                   need_coding$match_id)

added <- setdiff(need_coding$match_id,
                  coded_results %>% 
                     pull(match_id))

extras <- need_coding %>% filter(match_id %in% added) %>% 
  select(fred_id, ref_o, doi_o, study_o, ref_r, doi_r, url_r, link_r, study_r)

extra_dois <- extras$doi_r %>% na.omit() %>% unique()

map_chr(extra_dois, function(x) {
  if (is.na(x)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  possibly(rcrossref::cr_abstract, otherwise = NA_character_)(x) %>% unlist()
}, .progress = TRUE) -> extra_abstracts

extra_abstracts <- tibble(doi_r = extra_dois,
                          abstract_r = unlist(extra_abstracts))

extras <- extras %>% distinct()

extras %>% arrange(desc(fred_id %in% coded_entries$fred_id)) %>% 
  left_join(extra_abstracts) %>% 
  writexl::write_xlsx("final_studies_Sep.xlsx")

extras %>% left_join(extra_abstracts) %>% left_join(res) %>% filter(!is.na(success_rating)) %>% filter(!fred_id %in% coded_entries$fred_id) %>% writexl::write_xlsx("final_studies_AI_coded_Sep.xlsx")

# Filter for duplicated match_id - i.e. potentially several study_os
multi_o <- need_coding %>% 
  select(-fred_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(match_id) %>% 
  filter(n() > 1) %>% 
  pull(match_id) %>% 
  unique()

study_o_matches <- coded_results %>% 
  left_join(need_coding %>% 
              filter(!match_id %in% multi_o) %>% 
              select(match_id, study_o) %>% 
              distinct(), 
            by = "match_id") %>%
  mutate(study_o = case_when(
    match_id %in% multi_o ~ "MULTI?",
    TRUE ~ study_o
  )) %>% 
  select(fred_id, study_o)

check_o <- study_o_matches %>% distinct() %>% 
  group_by(fred_id) %>% 
  filter(n()>1)

coded_results %>% 
  filter(fred_id %in% check_o$fred_id) %>%
  select(fred_id, match_id, study_o) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(fred_id) %>% 
  View()
```

## Check tangential claims


```{r}

subj$abstract_o <- subj$doi_o %>% 
  map_chr(function(x) {
    if (is.na(x)) {
      return(NA_character_)
    }
    possibly(rcrossref::cr_abstract, otherwise = NA_character_)(x) %>% unlist()
  })


identify_key_claim <- function(abstract, claims) {
  
  if (is.na(abstract) || abstract == "") {
    return(list(key_claims = NA_character_, peripheral_claims = NA_character_))
  }
  
  claims_text <- glue::glue("[{claims$id}] {claims $claim_text_o}") %>% paste(sep = "\n\n", collapse = "\n\n")
  
  chat <- chat_openai()
  
  chat$chat_structured(
    paste0("We coded one or more claims made in an academic study. See the abstract and the list of claims below. Based on the abstract, identify whether the claims are central or peripheral to the message of the study. Return the claim IDs (provided in []) for each type, if any, as a comma-separated list. \n\nABSTRACT\n", abstract, "\n\nCLAIM(s)\n", claims_text),
    type = type_object(
      key_claims = type_string(),
      peripheral_claims = type_string(),
      unclear_claims = type_string()
    )
  )
}

subj <- subj %>% group_by(entry) %>% mutate(n_claims = n()) %>% ungroup()

summary(subj$n_claims)



```
